These loans support self-employment activities in fields such as legal profession, Chartered Accountancy, medical practice etc.

schemeName: Green Business Scheme - Haryana
briefDescription: Under this scheme, loans of up to ₹2.00 lakhs are provided to Scheduled Caste residents of Haryana for undertaking income-generating activities that help mitigate the greenhouse effect, such as e-rickshaws, compressed air vehicles, solar energy gadgets, polyhouses, and similar eco-friendly ventures.

schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Accident Insurance Scheme - Uttarakhand
briefDescription: Under this scheme, fish farmers are provided insurance coverage of ₹5 lakh in case of accidental death/total permanent disability, ₹2.5 lakh for partial disability, & ₹50,000 for hospitalization. No premium is required to be paid by fish farmers, entire cost of the insurance is fully borne by Dept.

schemeName: Atma Nirbhar Plantation Yojana

schemeName: Kisan Credit Card (Pashupalan)

briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to Anganwadi workers, mini workers, and assistants of the state upon attaining the superannuation age of 60 years. A minimum amount of ₹30,000/- is granted, while those completing 20 years of service receive ₹1,30,000/-.

schemeName: Livelihood Opportunity Promotion Scheme (Scheduled Caste)

The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the PIPDIC portal.

schemeName: AASRA Scheme

schemeName: Bank Tie-Up Scheme

schemeName: Term Loan Scheme- Credit Line 1 for Minority Community

schemeName: Term Loan under NSKFDC- Haryana

schemeName: Mahila Samiriddhi Yojana for Minority Community

schemeName: Grant for the Purchase of Work Related Tools for the Construction Workers

schemeName: Interest Free Loan (CBOCWWB)

schemeName: Eja-Boi Shagun Yojana
briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote the safe health and well-being of mothers and newborns by encouraging institutional deliveries and ensuring that mothers stay in government hospitals for at least 48 hours after childbirth.

briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote menstrual hygiene and prevent reproductive tract infections among adolescent girls aged 10 to 19 years in Uttarakhand by providing sanitary napkins at a nominal cost of ₹6/-, available through all ASHA workers across the state.

schemeName: Union Territory of Lakshadweep Pension Scheme for Widows

Financial assistance of ₹500 in the form of a National Savings Certificate is provided to lactating mothers.

schemeName: Educational Allowances to the Children of Widows

schemeName: Mahila Kisan Yojana (Maharashtra)

The scheme aims to uplift the lifestyle of economically disadvantaged Charmakar communities. it supports the production and sale of various types of footwear and leather articles.

schemeName: WISE Post-Doctoral Fellowship

schemeName: Sanitary Napkin Scheme (UKBOCWWB)

schemeName: Gargi Sanskrit Balika Chhaatravrtti Yojana

briefDescription: The scheme “The Andaman & Nicobar Islands Widow Pension Scheme” is implemented by the Directorate of Social Welfare, Union Territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands to provide financial assistance to poor and destitute widows in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.

schemeName: The Andaman & Nicobar Islands Allowance to Destitute Women Scheme
briefDescription: The scheme “The Andaman & Nicobar Islands Allowance to Destitute Women Scheme” is implemented by the Directorate of Social Welfare, Union Territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands to provide financial assistance to the poorest and destitute women in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.

schemeName: Mukhyamantri Covid-19 Bal Seva Yojana
briefDescription: The Mukhyamantri Covid-19 Bal Seva Yojana scheme for children who have lost their parent(s) to the COVID pandemic, the government will provide these children funding for good education and health.

schemeName: Matritva, Shishu Evam Baalika Madad Yojana
briefDescription: "Maatrtv, Shishu Evan Baalika Madad Yojana" is a initiative of Uttar Pradesh state Government to provide the financial assistance to the mother and her girl child.

schemeName: Grant of Financial Assistance to Poor Scheduled Caste Pregnant & Lactating Women
briefDescription: The scheme “Grant of Financial Assistance to Poor Scheduled Caste Pregnant & Lactating Women” was introduced by the Adi Dravidar Welfare Department, Government of Puducherry. The objective of the scheme is to provide assistance for the well-being of Pregnant and Lactating mothers and their children.

schemeName: Maternity Benefit (A.B.O.C.W.W.B)
briefDescription: The scheme “Maternity Benefit” was started by the Assam Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (A.B.O.C.W.W.B), Labour Welfare Department, Government of Assam for providing financial assistance to the registered women beneficiaries as maternity benefits during the period of maternity.

schemeName: Reimbursement of Tuition Fees for Typewriting and Shorthand Courses for Children of Widows
briefDescription: “Reimbursement of Tuition Fees for Typewriting and Shorthand Courses for Children of Widows” by the Dept of Women & Child Development, Govt of Pondicherry, was introduced to encourage the children of widows to pursue Typewriting and Shorthand courses and facilitate the reimbursement of course fees.

schemeName: Grant of Marriage Allowance to the Widow's Daughter
briefDescription: This scheme aims to provide financial support to widows for the marriage of their daughters. Eligible widows can receive ₹25,000/- to cover marriage expenses. The scheme is implemented through the Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Puducherry.

schemeName: Theka Shramik, Gharelu Mahila Kamgar Evan Hamal Shramik Prasuti Sahayta Yojana
briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Theka Shramik, Gharelu Mahila Kamgar Evan Hamal Shramik Prasuti Sahayta Yojana" for unorganized worker on 11 March 2015.

schemeName: Gharelu Mahila Kamgar Cycle, Chhatari, Chappal/Joota Sahayta Yojana
briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Gharelu Mahila Kamgar Cycle, Chhatari, Chappal/Joota Sahayta Yojana" for unorganized worker on 11 March 2015.

schemeName: Assistance for Delivery of a Child or the Miscarriage of Pregnancy or the Termination of Pregnancy
briefDescription: The scheme "Assistance for Delivery of a Child or the Miscarriage of Pregnancy or the Termination of Pregnancy" was launched by the Art and Culture Department, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to give financial assistance for the delivery of a child, miscarriage, or termination of pregnancy

schemeName: Annai Teresa Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme for Orphan Girls-II
briefDescription: "Annai Teresa Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme for Orphan Girls-I" was launched by the Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Dept, Govt of Tamil Nadu. The scheme provides financial assistance to the orphan girls for their marriage. The bride should be 18 years or older during her marriage.

schemeName: Lalima Abhiyaan
briefDescription: The Lalima Abhiyaan aims to improve the health of children, adolescent girls, and women of reproductive age, and focuses on the prevention of anemia and nutrition awareness among adolescent girls.

schemeName: Maternity Benefit to the Female Beneficiary
briefDescription: The Manipur Building and Other Construction Workers' Welfare Board (MBOCWWB) provide "Maternity Benefit" to female workers registered under the Act. Financial assistance is provided in cases of miscarriage or medical termination of pregnancy, up to two times.

schemeName: Samekit Baal Vikas Chhtra Yojana: Dress for Pre-school Children
briefDescription: This scheme provides an amount of ₹400/- per child per year for uniforms to all children aged 3 to 6 years receiving pre-school education at Anganwadi Centres. The scheme aims to create a distinct identity for Anganwadi Centre children & bring a sense of uniformity & social harmony among children.

schemeName: Mukhyamantri Vidwa Evam Ekal Naari Awas Yojana
briefDescription: The "Mukhyamantri Vidwa Evam Ekal Naari Awas Yojana" was launched by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Himachal Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide financial grants for the construction of houses to economically weak widows and single women.

schemeName: Mukhya Mantri Mahila Sashaktikaran Yojana
briefDescription: Under this scheme, permanent training will be provided for the economic and social upliftment of women suffering from any form of violence and living in difficult circumstances so that they can get employment.

schemeName: Scholarship for Fatherless Girls
briefDescription: The objective of this scheme is to support the education of girls who have lost their fathers and are studying in government schools. Under this scheme, scholarships ranging from ₹350/- to ₹450/- are provided to eligible girls from Class 1 to Class 12.

schemeName: Additional Pension to Widow of Ex-Serviceman having No Child
briefDescription: Under the scheme, an additional amount of ₹100/- per month, in addition to the pension amount, is provided to the widow of an ex-serviceman who dies while in service but not in any battle.

schemeName: Scheme for Relief and Rehabilitation of Women Acid Victims
briefDescription: Under the scheme, the acid attack victim is entitled to receive 100% free medical treatment from government or government-approved hospitals. Additionally, an ad-hoc relief of ₹1.00 lakh is provided to the acid attack victim, which is later reimbursed by the Women and Child Development Department.

schemeName: Sanitary Pad Supply Scheme
briefDescription: The "Sanitary Pad Supply Scheme" by the Women, Child Development & Social Security Department, Government of Jharkhand, aims to promote hygiene and health among women and adolescent girls. It provides free sanitary pads quarterly to women aged 20–40 years through Anganwadi centers.

schemeName: Female Child Birth Gift Scheme (HPBOCWWB)
briefDescription: The "Female Child Birth Gift Scheme" by the HPBOCWWB offers ₹51,000/- for each of two daughters of registered beneficiaries. The amount is deposited in a Fixed Deposit Receipt (FDR) and can be withdrawn once the daughter turns 18, ensuring long-term financial security.

schemeName: Mukhyamantri Aadim Jan Jati Pension Yojana
briefDescription: The Mukhyamantri Aadim Jan Jati Pension Yojana, launched on 08-07-2015 by the Jharkhand Government, provides financial assistance to primitive tribal families. The pension is given to the adult married woman or, if none, the male head of the family.

schemeName: Pension to Widows and Destitute Women
briefDescription: Under this scheme, widows and destitute women aged 18 years and above are eligible for a pension if they are domiciles of Haryana and have been residing in the state for at least one year at the time of application submission.

schemeName: Tailoring Training To Scheduled Caste & Backward Classes Widows/Destitute Women/Girls
briefDescription: The aim of the scheme is to enable Scheduled Caste Widows/girls/destitute women for self-employment. A stipend of Rs.600/- P.M. and raw material costing Rs.300/- per month per trainee is given to a trainee for getting training from the nearest Kalyan Kendar run by this department.

schemeName: Financial Assistance To Poor & Needy Widow Women
briefDescription: "Financial Assistance to Poor & Needy Widow Women" is a scheme by the Department of Social Welfare, Govt. of Manipur. The objective of the scheme is to provide social security by way of financial assistance to widows in the age group of 18-40 years.

schemeName: Savitribai Phule Scholarship For V.J.N.T. And S.B.C. Girl Students Studying In 5th To 7th Standard
briefDescription: Savitribai Phule Scholarship is a Scholarship Scheme by the Social Justice and Special Assistance Dept., Govt. of Maharashtra, to encourage the enrollment and to decrease the dropout ratio of Girl Students of Maharashtra from Vimukta Jati and Nomadic Tribes and Special Backward Classes.

schemeName: Integrated Social Security Scheme - Women In Distress
briefDescription: ISSS (Integrated Social Security Scheme) is a State Sponsored Scheme by the Social Welfare Department of the Govt. of Jammu and Kashmir where financial assistance is provided to Old Age Persons, Widows, Divorcees, Women in Distress, Transgenders, and Physically Handicapped Persons.

schemeName: Pragati Scholarship Scheme For Girl Students (Technical Diploma)
briefDescription: A scholarship scheme by AICTE for Girl Students admitted in 1st or 2nd Year of the technical diploma course in an AICTE approved institution. The benefits are provided for a period of max. of 3 years for first-year students and a max. of 2 years for second-year admitted students (later entry).

schemeName: Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT Students - DNH & DD
briefDescription: Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC & DNT students of UT domicile with parental income below ₹2.5 lakh p.a. Academic allowance ₹5,000–₹20,000 p.a. for eligible courses. Online/correspondence students get tuition fees only. Institutes must have AISHE/UDISE code and NAAC/NBA accreditation.
beneficiaryState: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu

schemeName: Post Matric Scholarships to the Students Belonging to Scheduled Castes, DNH & DD
briefDescription: The scheme aims to increase higher education enrolment among Scheduled Caste students, especially those from poor households. Through this scheme, financial assistance towards fees and academic expenses is provided to eligible Scheduled Caste students.
beneficiaryState: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu

schemeName: Mission Saksham Anganwadi & Poshan 2.0, DNH & DD
schemeShortTitle: SS-DADRA AND NAGAR HAVELI AND DAMAN & DIU
briefDescription: The Union Territory of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu has successfully launched the "Mission Saksham Anganwadi & Poshan 2.0" scheme to provide nutritional support for children below 6 years of age, Pregnant Women and Lactating Mothers (PW&LM), and Adolescent Girls (14-18 years).
beneficiaryState: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu

schemeName: Agnipath Yojana
briefDescription: A welfare scheme by the Department of Military Affairs, MoD under which rigorous military training will be imparted to the youth aged between 17.5 to 23 years and meeting other educational, physical, and medical criteria, who are aspirational to be a part of the armed forces.

schemeName: Padma Awards
briefDescription: The scheme aims to recognize distinguished and exceptional achievements across various fields of public service and national importance.

schemeName: Police Medal for Meritorious Service
briefDescription: Under this scheme, medals, official recognition, and service distinction are provided to the personnel serving in police, CAPFs, CPOs, and other public safety organizations.

schemeName: Industrial Skill Development Allowance To The New Employees Employed In Industries In H.p
briefDescription: The Industrial Skill Development Allowance scheme, as announced in the Budget Speech of the Hon'ble Chief Minister for the Financial Year 2018-19, aims to provide financial assistance to eligible individuals employed in industries in Himachal Pradesh for their on-the-job skill upgradation

schemeName: Adventure Training for Youth
briefDescription: The scheme aims to empower the youth of Uttarakhand by providing free adventure training programs that develop their skills and capabilities through various adventure activities.

schemeName: Self-Employment Scheme for Unemployed Minority Communities
briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide a grant of 25% of the loan amount (for loans ranging from ₹1 lakh to ₹10 lakh) to individuals belonging to minority communities, who are permanent residents of Uttarakhand, for the purpose of self-employment.

schemeName: Financial Assistance for ANM/GNM/Technical Courses
briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide assistance to the youths of the Tea Tribes and Adivasi Community for training in job-assured technical and professional Diploma and Degree courses. It supports training for courses like ANM, GNM, and Para-Medical, with a minimum duration of one year.

schemeName: Tourist Guide Certification Scheme
briefDescription: The scheme aims to train and certify Goan youth as tourist guides through Basic and Advanced modules. It reimburses fees for the Basic course and sponsors the Advanced curriculum, creating employment and entrepreneurial opportunities in Goa’s tourism sector.

schemeName: Various Training and Support Schemes of Kisan Vigyan Kendra - Veer Chandra Singh Garhwali Uttarakhand University of Horticulture and Forestry
briefDescription: The scheme aims to enhance the knowledge, skills, and productivity of farmers in Uttarakhand by providing them with the latest technical training in agriculture, horticulture, and forestry.

schemeName: Tribals Development Plan: Motor Driving Training [Light & Heavy Vehicles]
briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide full financial coverage for motor driving training, including courses for Light Motor Vehicles and Heavy Motor Vehicles, specifically recognizing Goa’s future in the transport sector. It benefits eligible Tribal families in Goa whose annual income is below ₹1,20,000/-.

schemeName: Multimedia Training - Tamil Nadu
briefDescription: The Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Government of Tamil Nadu, launched the "Multimedia Training Program" for people with locomotor and hearing impairments.

schemeName: Scheme of Encouragement to Young Artists
briefDescription: "Scheme of Encouragement to Young Artists" was launched by the Art and Culture Department, Tamil Nadu aims to give a chance to talented young artists to perform in four programs through the successfully running Voluntary Cultural Organization & grant given to the artiste for performing the programs.

schemeName: Scheme of Giving Awards to Eminent Artists - Kalai Ilamani Award
briefDescription: "Scheme of Giving Awards to Eminent Artists - Kalai Ilamani Award" was launched by the Art and Culture Department, Government of Tamil Nadu aims to promote and preserve the culture of Tamil Nadu. The selected artists are awarded financial assistance ₹4,000/- and certificates of appreciation.

schemeName: Mukhyamantri Sports Development Scheme - Retired Person
briefDescription: Launched on 9th February 2024 the "Mukhyamantri Sports Development Scheme-Retired Person" was launched by the Directorate of Youth Affairs & Sports, Govt. of Tripura. The scheme aims to generate employment opportunities for retired persons by giving a monthly fixed remuneration of ₹30,000/-.

schemeName: Skill Development Scheme (PBAOCWWB)
briefDescription: The Board is implementing this scheme by entering an MoU with M/s Labour Net Services Private Limited and M/s G&G Skill Developers Private Limited, to provide training to the Construction Workers enrolled as beneficiaries in the Board. The applications are accepted offline.

schemeName: “Training in Coir” Component of the "Development of Coir" Scheme
briefDescription: The scheme “Training in Coir” by the Dept of Industries and Commerce, UT of Puducherry aims to promote and develop Coir and Coir-based industries in the region. Additionally, it focuses on providing a 6-month training to the rural poor in producing coir products to generate employment.

schemeName: "Advanced Training in Handicrafts" Component of the "Development of Handicrafts" Scheme
briefDescription: Through the "Advanced Training in Handicrafts" scheme, candidates will be sponsored for training in other states where the craft is practised to its finest. The training program focuses on enhancing craft skills, enabling participants to acquire advanced techniques and proficiency in their craft.

schemeName: Unemployment Allowance Scheme
briefDescription: The Department of Labour and Employment, Government of Himachal Pradesh introduced Unemployment Allowance Scheme to provide allowance to eligible educated unemployed youth of Himachal, to enable them to sustain themselves for a certain period.

schemeName: The Scheme Of State Award For Disabled
briefDescription: The "The Scheme of State Award for Disabled" is a scheme by the Dept. of Social Justice & Special Assistance, Govt. of Maharashtra. In this scheme, every year, the State Government felicitates awards to the Best Disabled Employees/Employers/Placement Agencies who have done outstanding work.

schemeName: Mukhyamantri Shramshakti Yojana
briefDescription: This scheme aims to provide employment opportunities to men and women aged 18 to 45 from the minority community by offering vocational skill training in various fields or by providing loans through the Bihar State Minority Financial Corporation, Patna, for self-employment.

schemeName: Mukhyamantri Prakhand Parivahan Yojana
briefDescription: "Mukhyamantri Prakhand Parivahan Yojana" to provide transportation facilities connecting blocks & remote Panchayats with district headquarters. This scheme aims to encourage scheduled castes, scheduled tribes, backward classes entrepreneurship by providing financial support to purchase buses.

schemeName: Scheme of Financial Assistance for Dance and Drama Troupes/Associations
briefDescription: The "Scheme of Financial Assistance for Dance and Drama Troupes/Associations" was launched by the Arts and Culture Department, Puducherry. The scheme aims to provide a grant for dance and drama troupes/associations.

schemeName: Empower ST/SC Communities using ICT Tools through IT Knowledge Centre (ITKC)
briefDescription: "Empower ST/SC Communities using ICT Tools through IT Knowledge Centre (ITKC)" by the Department of Information Technology, Electronics and Communication, Government of Goa aims to create a large pool of computer literate manpower and to make introducing e-governance solutions meaningful.

schemeName: Jharkhand State Migrant Labourers Survey and Rehabilitation Scheme
briefDescription: The "Jharkhand State Migrant Labourers Survey and Rehabilitation Scheme" aims to identify and support migrant workers from the state. The scheme ensures social security, rehabilitation, and welfare for migrant workers and their families.

schemeName: Block Level Institute for Rural Skill Acquisition (BIRSA)
briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free, localized skill training to candidates at the block level in Jharkhand. The program is non-residential and operates in 24 districts across 80 blocks in the first phase.

schemeName: Mukhymantri Sarthi Yojana - Jharkhand
briefDescription: The "Mukhymantri Sarthi Yojana" aims to provide industry-relevant skill development training for youth in Jharkhand, aligning with NSQF standards. Implemented by Jharkhand Skill Development Mission Society (JSDMS) across all 24 districts, it offers free training to enhance employability.

schemeName: Vocational Training to the Dependents
briefDescription: The "Vocational Training to the Dependents" provides a residential skill training program for 15,000 dependents of registered construction workers. The program focuses on enhancing the employability of dependents through training in various trades.

schemeName: Research Associates (RA)
briefDescription: The Research Associates (RAs) of the Department of Biotechnology (DBT) in India are individuals who engage in research work under the DBT-Research Associateship Program in Biotechnology and its was started in 1999.

schemeName: National Career Service Centers For SC/STs (Erstwhile Coaching-cum-Guidance Centre for SC/STs)
briefDescription: The scheme provides vocational guidance, confidence-building programmes, personality development sessions, practice in typing and shorthand, special coaching for competitive exams, and computer training courses. The applicant must be an educated, unemployed SC/ST jobseeker.

schemeName: Craftsmen Training Scheme
briefDescription: The scheme aims to ensure steady flow of skilled workers in different trades for domestic industry and reduce unemployment among educated youth. It provides systematic vocational training through Industrial Training Institutes and National Skill Training Institutes across India.
nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Skill Development And Entrepreneurship

schemeName: The Inland Waterways Authority of India Internship Scheme
briefDescription: The purpose of this scheme is to provide with Selected Candidates” short term exposure to different verticals/ divisions/ units of IWAI as “Interns”. An intern may be required to work at Head Office or Project Office depending upon the requirement of the Authority.

schemeName: Sagar Samman Award- Sagar Samman Award for Gallantry
briefDescription: Under this scheme, recognition is provided to Indian seafarers who risk their lives to save others or protect the marine environment.

schemeName: President’s Medal for Distinguished Service
briefDescription: The scheme aims to recognize exceptional service, distinguished records, and meritorious contributions in police, security, fire, prison, and civil defence services.

schemeName: SITARE-Appreciation Grant
briefDescription: SITARE-Appreciation Grant: Residential workshops called as Biotech Innovation Ignition School (BIIS) for undergraduate students are organized to provide hands-on technical training and mentorship for problem identification in 3-4 weeks duration.

schemeName: Technical Internship Programme
briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide practical technical experience through live projects. Under this programme, a 6-month internship with a stipend of ₹20,000/- per month is offered to eligible engineering students.
nodalMinistryName: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

schemeName: Modular Employable Skills
briefDescription: The SDIS is a government initiative for improving employability through vocational training. It's a partnership between government and industry to provide skills development programs for early school dropouts and workers in unorganized sector.

schemeName: Toolkit Assistance (UKBOCWWB)
briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide registered construction workers with a toolkit, including hand gloves and other construction-related tools, worth up to ₹10,000/-.

schemeName: State Level Awards for Divyang Persons
briefDescription: Under this scheme, a cash prize of ₹8,000/-, along with a medal and a certificate of appreciation, is awarded to outstanding individuals in categories such as disabled employees, outstanding sportspersons, and best self-employed service providers.

schemeName: Free Pre-Recruitment Training
briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide 8 weeks of free pre-recruitment training for recruitment into the Military, Paramilitary, and Police Forces to sons of ex-servicemen aged between 16 and 21 years who have passed high school with at least 45% marks.

schemeName: Scheme for Giving Stipend to the Trainees Belonging to the Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe Community Enrolled under Various Labour Welfare Centres in the State of Goa
briefDescription: The scheme aims to give benefits under the Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan and Tribal Sub-Plan to Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe trainees enrolled under various Labour Welfare Centres in the State of Goa. Eligible trainees receive a monthly stipend of ₹1,000/- to support their training in crafts.

schemeName: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Incentive for Self Employment
briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance not exceeding ₹50,000/- or the actual cost, whichever is less, to needy Goan artists or their families for setting up self-employment ventures, helping them establish sustainable income sources. The applications for this scheme are accepted Offline.

schemeName: Special Basic Mountaineering Course
briefDescription: The scheme aims to enhance mountaineering skills among youth, prepare them to become certified guides, and promote adventure tourism in Uttarakhand.

schemeName: P1, P2, P3, P4, SIV, Guided Flying
briefDescription: The aim of the scheme is to train and develop skilled youth of Uttarakhand, aged between 18 to 30 years, who are educated, mentally, and physically fit, to become professional paragliding pilots and instructors.

schemeName: PM-Special Training of Geriatric Caregivers
briefDescription: The scheme aims to train and create a professional cadre of geriatric caregivers to meet the increasing demand for specialized care for senior citizens. It offers skill development and certification in geriatric care job roles to Indian citizens, ensuring professional services for the elderly.
nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment

schemeName: SAKSHAM - KVK 2.0
briefDescription: The scheme aims to equip beneficiaries with skills for employability and entrepreneurship at taluka/village level across Gujarat. It provides skill development training through Short-Term Training and Special Projects for diverse beneficiaries.

schemeName: Shilpi Gram Scheme (Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe)
briefDescription: The scheme aims to re-establish traditional artisan skills among SC/ST communities. It provides free training, infrastructure support, and marketing opportunities to artisans in selected artisan villages.

schemeName: Rural Technology Complex
briefDescription: The scheme "Rural Technology Complex" by the Programme Implementation Department, Government of Uttarakhand, aims to enhance livelihood opportunities in the Himalayan region through the use of local, need-based and environment-friendly technologies.

schemeName: Mukhyamantri Pichhda Varg Evam Ati Pichhda Varg Kaushal Vikas Prashikshan Yojana
briefDescription: The scheme aims to improve employability through free skill training for youth of backward and extremely backward communities.

schemeName: Kachara Binane Vaale Hetu Suraksha Upakaran Sahaayata Yojana
briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Kachara Beenane Vaale Hetu Suraksha Upakaran Sahaayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 19 June 2017.

schemeName: Development of Industrie-Training Scheme
briefDescription: The Government of Puducherry introduced the Scheme Development Of Industries-Training Scheme for the candidates to develop their skills to enable them to start their own ventures or to get suitable employment opportunity by sponsoring to selected short term trades.

schemeName: Swanirbhar Naari
briefDescription: The Swanirbhar Naari scheme, initiated by the Directorate of Handloom & Textiles, Assam, aims to promote traditional hand-woven items by procuring them directly from indigenous weavers.

schemeName: Chief Minister’s Yuva Kaushal Yojana
briefDescription: The scheme “Chief Minister’s Yuva Kaushal Yojana (CM YKY)” was launched by the government of Arunachal Pradesh on 1st April 2018 to provide high-end training to the youth across the state to enable them to find jobs in the private sector.

schemeName: Special Education And Vocational Training Through Government Institutions
briefDescription: In this scheme, Special Education is provided to children with disability between the age group of 6 to 18 years in the Government Special Schools and Vocational Training is provided to special children above the age of 18 years. Only citizens who are permanent residents of Maharashtra are eligible.

schemeName: "Advance/High Skill Training in Coir" Component of the "Development of Coir" Scheme
briefDescription: "Advance/High Skill Training in Coir" aims to enhance the skills of Coir artisans and interested individuals. The objective is to acquire the latest skills and modern technologies through advanced/high-skilled training available across various locations in India, offering valuable benefits.

schemeName: "Vocational Training" Component of the "Development of Industries" Scheme
briefDescription: "Vocational Training" by the Department of Industries and Commerce, Union Territory of Puducherry aims to create more employment opportunities broadly for the unemployed youth particularly women to pursue wide career openings besides self-ventures by giving training in trades.

schemeName: "Advance / High Skill Training" Component of the "Development of Industries" Scheme
briefDescription: The scheme aims to enhance the skill of those who have completed the basic training and are interested in advanced training in their trade or the candidates having technical qualifications willing to undergo some special high skilled training to start their ventures or to get suitable employment.

schemeName: FutureSkills Prime Incentive Program
briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote a novel skilling ecosystem in the country, the programme/scheme would incentivize the cost of the eligible course(s) concerned, providing authentic and accredited certifications that are acceptable in the industry.
nodalMinistryName: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

schemeName: Nehru Child Literature Prize
briefDescription: The Arts and Culture Department of Puducherry launched the "Nehru Child Literature Prize" scheme for authors/writers. Financial assistance with a certificate will be provided for their contribution to children's literature books published in Tamil.

schemeName: Scheme of Financial Assistance for Publication of Manuscripts/Research Journals
briefDescription: The "Scheme of Financial Assistance for Publication of Manuscripts/Research Journals" was launched by the Arts and Culture Department of Puducherry. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for publishing manuscripts/research journals.

schemeName: Fitter Training to Hearing Impaired Persons
briefDescription: The scheme "Fitter Training to Hearing Impaired Persons" was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to give fitter training to the hearing-impaired candidates at the ITI, Guindy for two years and a stipend of ₹300 per month.

schemeName: AlCTE - Distinguished Professional Scheme
briefDescription: AICTE-Distinguished Professionals Scheme has been launched by the All India Council for Technical Education, Ministry of Education to improve the quality of Technical Education in India by utilizing the expertise of Professionals, Emeritus professors & Eminent Personalities to share their knowledge.

schemeName: Poompuhar State Award
briefDescription: "Poompuhar State Award" was launched by the Dept of Handlooms, Handicrafts, Textiles & Khadi, Tamil Nadu. The awardees are given ₹50,000, a 4-gram gold medal, tamirapathiram and a certificate. The economically backward awardees are also eligible for monthly pension of ₹3,500/- after 60 years of age.

schemeName: Scheme of Extending Financial Assistance to Folk Artists, Troupes for the Purchase of Musical Instruments, Costumes
briefDescription: "Scheme of Extending Financial Assistance to Folk Artists, Troupes for the Purchase of Musical Instruments, Costumes" was launched by the Art and Culture Department, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme provides a sum of ₹2,000/- to individual folk artists & ₹6,000/- for cultural troupes.

schemeName: One Time Cash Incentive towards acquiring BEd, BPEd, DTEd, PGDCA (Sainik Welfare)
briefDescription: "One Time Cash Incentive towards acquiring BEd, BPEd, DTEd, PGDCA" is a Welfare Scheme by the Armed Forces Flag Day Fund of the Department of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry. Through this scheme, up to ₹20,000/- is provided to the unemployed Ex-servicemen to pursue the mentioned programs/courses.

schemeName: Scheme of Giving Awards to Eminent Artists - Kalai Valarmani Award
briefDescription: "Scheme of Giving Awards to Eminent Artists - Kalai Valarmani Award" by the Art and Culture Department, Government of Tamil Nadu aims to promote and preserve the culture of Tamil Nadu. The selected artists are awarded financial assistance ₹6,000/- and certificates of appreciation.

schemeName: Grant for Purchase of Tools (BBOCWWB)
briefDescription: The scheme is implemented by the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. Under this scheme, registered construction workers who have completed skill upgradation training are provided financial assistance of upto ₹15,000/- for purchasing trade-related tools.

schemeName: Skill Development Training Karnataka
briefDescription: The Skill Development Training program aims to equip artisans with the skills necessary for the manufacture of footwear and leather goods. The project promotes the leather industry while enhancing the livelihoods of artisans.

schemeName: Community Based Training Scheme
briefDescription: The "Community Based Training Scheme" aims to provide training in heavy vehicle driving, shorthand, security services, office soft skills, retail sales, and beauty parlor courses (male & female) to unemployed young men and women belonging to minority communities for self-employment or employment.

schemeName: Nursing Kaushal College Jharkhand
briefDescription: The "Nursing Skill College" scheme provides skill-based nursing education and employment opportunities to young women, especially from disadvantaged backgrounds. The scheme offers free residential training, modern learning facilities, and placement support.

schemeName: Mukhyamantri Anusuchit Janjati Gram Vikas Yojana
briefDescription: The scheme "Mukhyamantri Anusuchit Janjati Gram Vikas Yojana" by the Welfare Department, Govt. of Jharkhand, aims to uplift Scheduled Tribe communities through education, health, & economic initiatives. Financial grants, equipment, & training programs are provided for holistic village development.

schemeName: Jharkhand Patrakar Samman Pension Niyamawali
briefDescription: The "Jharkhand Patrakar Samman Pension Niyamawali" aims to provide financial assistance to journalists who have served the state for an extended period. It ensures their well-being post-retirement and acknowledges their contribution to media and society.

schemeName: Employability Excellence with College Education & Learning (EXCEL)
briefDescription: The EXCEL program is a skill development initiative by the Jharkhand Government targeting 10+2 pass-out or university-level students. It integrates skill training with traditional education programs in colleges to improve employability.

schemeName: Nirman Shramik Safety Kit Yojana

schemeName: National Youth Corps

schemeName: Social Security for Tea Plantation Workers in Assam

schemeName: Chemical Promotion Development Scheme

It provides Grants-in-Aid to organisations and industry associations for conducting studies, seminars, and workshops.

schemeName: Entrepreneurship and Skill Development Programme

schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Dakshta Aur Kushalta Sampann Hitgrahi (PM-DAKSH)
briefDescription: The scheme "PM-DAKSH", launched by the Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment (MoSJ&E), aims to empower socially, educationally, and economically marginalized groups like SCs, OBCs, EWS, DNTs, Safai Mitras, and Waste Pickers by enhancing their skills through high-quality training.
nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment

schemeName: Youth Art Training Fellowship Scheme

schemeName: PMMSY: Construction of Fish Kiosks Including Kiosks of Aquarium/Ornamental Fish-Haryana
briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide central assistance for the construction of fish kiosks, including those for aquarium/ornamental fish.

schemeName: Pre-Examination Coaching Scheme

schemeName: Skill Development and Economic Empowerment
briefDescription: The scheme "Skill Development and Economic Empowerment" aims to provide vocational training and skill enhancement for visually challenged individuals. Through this scheme, free education, food, accommodation, and training in various job-oriented fields are provided to eligible candidates.

schemeName: Scholarship to Undergo Advanced Training in the Field of Art
briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to provide facilities to Goan talented students to undergo advanced training in the field of various disciplines of Art, i.e. Indian Classical Music and Dance, Drama, Western Music, Folk Art, Puppetry, Painting, Sculpture, etc.. Scholarship of ₹3,000/- per month.

schemeName: Theatre Workshop
briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to provide scientific knowledge of theatre to upcoming theatre artistes through an expert theatre personality. The workshops are organised on the written request of institutions working in the field of theatre and educational institutions for their students.

schemeName: Tiatr Script Writing Workshop
briefDescription: The scheme's objective is to enrich and promote the writing skills of Tiatr playwrights and to have a healthy and constructive discussion on various aspects of Tiatr script writing amongst the Tiatr writers, participating institutions and artistes. Lunch & refreshments are provided to participants.

schemeName: Special Jobs to PwDs - Clerical Assistant

Through this scheme, PwDs are employed as Clerical Assistants for 89 Days under the District Panchayat offices of their respective islands.

schemeName: IT Saksham Yuva Scheme
briefDescription: The Haryana Government is to provide employment opportunities to youths (graduate/post-graduate applicants) from engineering and IT backgrounds who shall undertake the Haryana IT Program (specially designed short-term courses) for the duration of a minimum of 3 months offered.

schemeName: Mukhyamantri Protsahan Yojana Jharkhand
briefDescription: The "Mukhyamantri Protsahan Yojana" by the Labour, Employment, Training & Skill Development Department, Government of Jharkhand, provides financial assistance to unemployed candidates who have completed skill training programs aligned with NSQF.

schemeName: Prime Minister’s Rural Development Fellows Scheme
briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide short term catalytic support to the District Administration in backward districts to improve programme delivery and simultaneously develop a cadre of Development Facilitators. Fellows receive professional experience, structured learning, and a monthly stipend.

schemeName: 6% Interest Subsidy on Loans taken through Banks up to a Limit of Rs.5 Lakh for Self-Employment
briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote self-employment among scheduled tribe (ST) individuals by making business loans affordable. Under this scheme, ST beneficiaries availing loans for self-employment are provided a interest subsidy to reduce financial burden and encourage entrepreneurship.

schemeName: Life Saving Technique Water Sports Operator

schemeName: Employment Linked Skill Training Programme (ELSTP)
briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free, self-employment-oriented training courses to unemployed/school dropouts/other disadvantaged youth of the state. It is a state-sponsored scheme that offers training in fields such as IT, healthcare, agriculture, beauty and wellness, electronics, and more.

schemeName: Scheme for Fruit and Vegetable Preservation and Training Program in Horticulture Department HRT 5
briefDescription: The "Scheme for Fruit and Vegetable Preservation and Training Program in Horticulture Department HRT 5" aims to enhance the skills of women through training on value addition, preservation, and kitchen gardening of horticultural produce, while also providing a daily stipend and training support.

schemeName: Viksit Delhi CM Internship Programme
briefDescription: The programme aims to harness the energy and innovative ideas of the youth pursuing graduation and post-graduation of India, which will be implemented in policy and decision making, to make Delhi a smart, clean, caring and prosperous metropolis.

schemeName: Subsidy on Rehri alongwith (Stove, Gas Chulha, Utensil etc.) for the Fish/Fish Product Sale
briefDescription: Under this scheme, financial assistance will be provided for purchase of a handcart along with essential items such as stove, gas chulha, utensils, etc., for fish and fish product sales. A subsidy of 60% on the total project cost of ₹60,000/- will be granted, amounting to ₹36,000/- per beneficiary.

schemeName: Incentives to Industries For Training Prospective Employees Scheme
briefDescription: The scheme aims to address the skill gap in Goa by supporting industrial units to provide demand-driven Short Term Training Courses through recognized institutions, thereby creating manpower suitable for the industry. It offers reimbursement for 60% of training costs up to ₹60,000/- per trainee.

schemeName: Scheme for Providing Counseling to the Trainees of Government Industrial Training Institutes at Directorate of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship
briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide youth-friendly counseling services in Government Industrial Training Institutes, delivered by appointed Counselors, to assist trainees suffering from mental, physical, or psychological stress. The benefit is the provision of a safe, confidential space.

schemeName: Ambedkar Social Innovation and Incubation Mission (ASIIM)
briefDescription: The scheme aims to boost entrepreneurship and innovation among SC students and SC differently-abled youth by providing focused support to translate innovative, technology-oriented business ideas into successful commercial enterprises. It offers equity funding and hand-holding support.

schemeName: Community Food Processing Centre
briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote skill development and entrepreneurship in food processing by enabling individuals and farmers to process fruits and vegetables, add value to their produce, and enhance income opportunities through community-based facilities.

schemeName: The Grant of Honorarium to Legal Researcher Scheme
briefDescription: The scheme aims to engage Legal Research Assistants to handle legal issues and court matters for major Departments of the Administration, thereby ensuring timely submission of defense documents and reducing departmental embarrassment in Courts. It gives fixed honorarium of ₹25,000/- per month.

schemeName: Nai Hetu Avashyak Upkaran Sahayata Yojana
briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Nai Hetu Avashyak Upkaran Sahayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 27 January 2018.

schemeName: Advocate Grant

schemeName: Tool Kit Grant for Traditional Handicrafts Experts
briefDescription: The “Tool Kit Grant for Traditional Handicrafts Experts” scheme is launched for the purpose for improving the productivity and competitiveness of the traditional OBC craftsmen ensuring quality goods for enhanced income and thereby qualitative improvement in their living conditions.

schemeName: Assistance to Traditional Pottery Makers
briefDescription: The scheme “Assistance to Traditional Pottery Makers” provides financial assistance to Traditional Pottery makers belonging to the state OBC category for the purchase of modern machinery for job modernization.

schemeName: Short Term Professional Training Courses

schemeName: Chief Minister’s Free Cancer Chemotherapy Scheme

schemeName: Medical Assistance (APB&OCWWB)
briefDescription: The scheme “Medical Assistance” was started by the Department of Labour and Employment, Govt. of Arunachal Pradesh for the registered workers of Arunachal Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (APB&OCWWB).

schemeName: Chief Minister’s Health Insurance Scheme - Nagaland
briefDescription: Launched on 16th October 2022, the scheme "Chief Minister Health Insurance Scheme (CMHIS)" is a Public Health Insurance Scheme by the Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Nagaland. schemeName: Rajasthan Chief Minister's Relief Fund - Medical Help
briefDescription: Rajasthan Chief Minister’s Relief Fund – medical help scheme launched on April 1999 under Chief Minister’s Relief Fund in Rajasthan for Individual for Non BPL whose family income should be at least 2lakhs per annum.

schemeName: Immunization Programme - Uttarakhand
briefDescription: This initiative aims to protect every child from preventable, life-threatening diseases by providing free and timely vaccination as per the National Immunization Schedule.

schemeName: Mukhyamantri Bal Hridaya Upchar Yojana
briefDescription: The scheme provides financial assistance ranging from ₹25,000/- to ₹1,00,000/- for treatment, covering 07 identified heart diseases in children. Key features include covering costs for treatment at recognized government or private hospitals.

schemeName: AYUSH Health and Wellness Centre - Ayushman Bharat Yojana
briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide accessible, affordable, and holistic healthcare services based on Ayurveda, Yoga, Unani and Homeopathy systems to people of all age groups.

schemeName: “Medical Camps (Allopathy and Indian systems of Medicine)" under Grant-in-Aid to Pondicherry Society for the Care of the Aged (PONCARE)
briefDescription: “Medical Camps (Allopathy and Indian systems of Medicine)" under the umbrella scheme "Grant-in-Aid to Pondicherry Society for the Care of the Aged" was launched by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry. The senior citizens are provided free health checkups and free medicines.

schemeName: Financial Assistance to Poor Scheduled Caste People Suffering From Prolonged Diseases
briefDescription: The scheme “Financial Assistance to Poor Scheduled Caste People Suffering From Prolonged Diseases” was introduced by the Adi Dravidar Welfare Dept, Govt of Puducherry. The objective of the scheme is to assist poor patients from Scheduled Castes suffering from prolonged illness.

schemeName: Nirmaan Shramik Mrtyu Evan Divyaang Sahaayata Yojana
briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started "Nirmaan Shramik Mrtyu Evan Divyaang Sahaayata Yojana" for Building and other construction workers.

schemeName: Safai Karmakar Bahay Rogi Chikitsa Sahayata Yojana

schemeName: Mukhmantri Sehat Bima Yojana

schemeName: Free Medical Card for Media Persons
