briefDescription: The scheme “Teachers Associateship for Research Excellence (TARE)” was launched by Science & Engineering Research Board, Department of Science & Technology, Government of India which aims to facilitate mobility of faculty members working in State Universities /Colleges/Private Academic institutions.

schemeName: Sukhatme National Award in Statistics
briefDescription: The scheme aims to recognise excellence in statistical research and official statistics. Through this scheme, national recognition is provided to eligible Indian statisticians for lifetime or young achiever contributions.
nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Statistics and Programme Implementation

schemeName: Training/Capacity Building Programmes/Research work on Remote Sensing and GIS Applications
briefDescription: The scheme aims to strengthen scientific and technical capacity of researchers, students, and government personnel in the field of Remote Sensing and Geographic Information System (GIS) applications by providing training, conducting capacity-building programmes, and supporting research initiatives.

schemeName: The Goa State Journalist Awards Scheme
briefDescription: "The Goa State Journalist Awards Scheme" aims to encourage journalists to publish commendable news items, articles, or reports, fostering mass awareness. It provides awards, including a cash prize of ₹10,000/-, to eligible journalists in Goa.

schemeName: The Goa State Photo Contest And Exhibition Scheme
briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage local youths in photography and photojournalism, providing cash prizes and exhibition opportunities. The scheme offers cash prizes of ₹20,000/-, ₹16,000/-, and ₹12,000/- in each category. Entries from applicants born and residing in Goa are preferred.

schemeName: Abdul Kalam Technology Innovation National Fellowship
briefDescription: Indian National Academy of Engineering (INAE) will award "Abdul Kalam Technology Innovation National Fellowship" to outstanding engineers to recognize, encourage and support translational research by individuals to achieve excellence in engineering, innovation and technology development.

schemeName: KSCSTE Emeritus Scientist Scheme
briefDescription: The scheme “KSCSTE Emeritus Scientist Scheme” helps to provide opportunity to superannuated outstanding scientists to pursue research in their respective field of specialization and to harness their knowledge and erudition for the development of State.

schemeName: Science Communication and Popularization
briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote scientific thinking and awareness among citizens by providing support and funding to educational institutions, R&D organizations, and NGOs to organize science communication activities.

schemeName: Mobility Scheme
briefDescription: The Mobility Scheme is aimed to provide an opportunity to women scientists who are facing difficulties in their present job due to relocation (marriage, transfer of husband to any other location within the country, attending ailing parents, and accompanying children studying in different city).

schemeName: Biotechnology Research Innovation And Entrepreneurship Development (Bio-RIDE)
briefDescription: The scheme aims to foster innovation, promote bio-entrepreneurship, and strengthen India's position as a global leader in biomanufacturing and biotechnology. It provides seed funding, extramural grants, and infrastructure support to startups, enterprises, industries, and academia.

schemeName: Dr. Kailash Nath Katju for Science/Pandit Lajja Shankar Jha for Engineering & Technology/Dr. Hari Singh Gour for Social Sciences Awards
briefDescription: The scheme aims to honor outstanding research in science and social sciences by awarding ₹50,000 and a citation to eminent contributors.

schemeName: Madhya Pradesh Mission Excellence Scholarship
briefDescription: The scheme aims to support meritorious science students by providing monthly financial assistance of ₹1,000 to eligible students pursuing science education.

schemeName: Rashtriya Vigyan Puraskar
briefDescription: The objective of the Rashtriya Vigyan Puraskar (RVP) is to recognise the notable and inspiring contribution made by the scientists, technologists and innovators individually or in teams in various fields of science, technology and technology- led innovation.

schemeName: National Science Chair- Science Leadership
briefDescription: The main aim of the scheme is to recognise active eminent senior resident Indian superannuated scientists for their outstanding contributions both nationally and internationally, in the areas of Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics (STEM) & Medicine, to promote excellence and growth in R&D.

schemeName: National Science Chair- Scientific Excellence
briefDescription: The main aim of the scheme is to recognize active eminent senior resident Indian superannuated scientists for their outstanding contributions both nationally and internationally, in the areas of Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics (STEM) & Medicine, to promote excellence and growth in R&D.

schemeName: Solar Based Hydroponic System
briefDescription: The system aims to develop and promote an innovative solar-based hydroponic system that integrates solar energy with modern greenhouse technology and mobile application support.

schemeName: Organization of Various Conclaves and Felicitations to Encourage Women, Women Scientists, Teachers and Young Students
briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote and enhance scientific attitude and skill development of women, women scientists, teachers, and young students of the state by organizing conclaves and felicitating them.

schemeName: Goa State Working Journalists Welfare Scheme
briefDescription: "Goa State Working Journalists Welfare Scheme" aims to improve the welfare of working journalists retired from service in Goa and their families. It provides a monthly welfare fund of ₹ 7,500/- and family pension benefits for eligible journalists and their dependents.

schemeName: Kishore Vaigyanik Protsahan Yojana
briefDescription: The KVPY is a national fellowship program in basic sciences, initiated and funded by the Department of Science and Technology to attract exceptionally motivated students to pursue basic science courses and a research career in science.

schemeName: Swarnajayanti Fellowships Scheme
briefDescription: Under this scheme, a selected number of young scientists, with proven track record, are provided special assistance and support to enable them to pursue basic research in frontier areas of science and technology.

schemeName: National Quantum Mission (NQM)
briefDescription: The National Quantum Mission (NQM) supports research and development of advanced quantum technologies (like quantum computing and secure communication) so India can build cutting-edge capabilities and stay competitive in future tech.

schemeName: BIRAC Incubator SEED Fund (SEED)
briefDescription: The BIRAC Incubator SEED Fund (SEED) provides early-stage funding through incubators to biotech startups so they can develop their ideas into viable products and launch successful businesses.

schemeName: SPARSH – Social Innovation Programme for Products Affordable & Relevant to Social Health
briefDescription: The SPARSH programme supports innovators in developing affordable health-related solutions so that essential healthcare products can reach and benefit underserved communities.

schemeName: Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru Awards for Sciences/Engineering & Technological Sciences/Social Sciences
briefDescription: The scheme aims to honor outstanding research in sciences and social sciences by providing ₹1,00,000 and a citation to eminent Indian contributors to promote excellence.

schemeName: Fellowship for Training of Young Scientists
briefDescription: The scheme aims to support short-term advanced research training by providing fellowship and contingency support to young scientists of Madhya Pradesh.

schemeName: E-YUVA Scheme: BIRAC’s Innovation Fellows (for post graduates and above)
briefDescription: BIRAC’s Innovation fellows shall apply as an individual and are required to work full time at EYC. BIRAC’s Innovation Fellows are expected to initiate biotech startups. Hence, only proposals with potential to commercialize innovative products and technologies will be considered for support.

schemeName: Overseas Visiting Doctoral Fellowship
briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to build national capacity in frontier areas of Science and Engineering, which are of interest to India by providing research training to PhD students admitted in the Indian institutions in overseas universities / institutions of repute.

schemeName: TEC Internship Scheme
briefDescription: The ‘TEC Internship Scheme’ intends to engage 25 Interns in order to study/formulate/operationalize/assess various works/projects/policies etc. The internship will provide an opportunity for young scholars to contribute to the TEC work and have insight into the related technical work.

schemeName: The Operation of Production Linked Incentive Scheme (PLI) for Large Scale Electronics Manufacturing
briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial incentives to boost domestic manufacturing and attract large investments in the electronics value chain, including electronic components and semiconductor packaging.
nodalMinistryName: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

schemeName: WISE Fellowship for Ph.D.
briefDescription: The "WISE Fellowship for Ph.D. (WISE-PhD)" of the Department of Science and Technology aims to provide an opportunity to carry out Doctoral research in basic and applied sciences to women scientists and technologists between the age group of 27-45 years who want to pursue research in STEM fields.

schemeName: High Risk - High Reward Research
briefDescription: The Scheme for Funding "High Risk - High Reward Research" aims at supporting proposals that are conceptually new & risky, & if successful, expected to have a paradigm-shifting influence on the S&T.

schemeName: Ramanujan Fellowship
briefDescription: "Ramanujan Fellowship" was started by the Science and Engineering Research Board, Govt. of India for brilliant Indian scientists and engineers from outside India to take up scientific research positions in India, those Indian scientists/engineers who want to return to India from abroad.

schemeName: STEM Lab
briefDescription: It aims to promote hands-on learning in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics by establishing labs across all blocks, giving students and teachers practical exposure to STEM experiments.

schemeName: Research and Development Grant
briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage scientific research to address the state’s problems by providing grants and technical support to scientists, researchers, and academic institutions across the state.

schemeName: Biotechnology Young Entrepreneur Award
briefDescription: The “Biotechnology Young Entrepreneur Award (BYE)” is a programme to promote commercialisation of bioscience ideas among graduate/post graduate students in Biotechnology and to encourage them to develop biotechnology entrepreneurship.

schemeName: Scheme for Promoting Young Talents in Science-I
briefDescription: The scheme “Scheme for Promoting Young Talents in Science-I (SPYTiS-I)” is constituted for the purpose of providing financial and technical assistance to talented young students who have innovative ideas in scientific/technological pursuits.

schemeName: Scheme for Providing Financial Assistance for the Purchase of Laptop or Desktop Computer to the Media Persons of the Union Territory of Puducherry
briefDescription: The scheme aims to grant financial assistance for the purchase of laptops or desktop computers to eligible media persons, keeping in view the special nature of the service rendered by the Media Persons to society in creating a sense of socio-political awareness among the people.

schemeName: Junior Research Fellowship In Engineering & Technology
briefDescription: The scheme "Junior Research Fellowship in Engineering & Technology" by the University Grants Commission (UGC), Department of Higher Education is meant for candidates who wish to pursue research leading to a Ph.D. degree in engineering and technology.

schemeName: Prime Minister Research Chair (PMRC) Scheme - For Fellows
briefDescription: The scheme is a flagship national initiative that aims to attract & engage leading Indian-origin researchers, scientists & professionals from abroad & place them at premier government higher education institutions & national research laboratories in India to undertake cutting-edge research.

schemeName: Paired Early Career Fellowship in Applied Research
briefDescription: PECFAR is a fellowship to facilitate a two-way exchange of young early-career Indian and German researchers through short visits for networking and exploring avenues for collaboration and innovation in applied research.

schemeName: LEAP Fund – Launching Entrepreneurial Driven Affordable Products
briefDescription: The LEAP Fund supports entrepreneurs in creating affordable, innovative products so more people can access useful technologies while encouraging business growth.

schemeName: Young Scientist Program– M.P. Young Scientist Congress
briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote young scientific talent by providing research presentation opportunities, awards, and training fellowships to young scientists of Madhya Pradesh.”

schemeName: Vigyan Manthan Yatra
briefDescription: The "Vigyan Manthan Yatra" aims to nurture scientific talent by providing exposure visits, interactions with scientists, and scholarships to meritorious science students and teachers.

schemeName: Deen Dayal SPARSH Yojana (Scholarship For Promotion Of Aptitude & Research In Stamps As A Hobby)
briefDescription: "Deen Dayal SPARSH Yojana" awards annual scholarships to students who have good academic records and are also pursuing 'Philately' as a hobby. The objective is to “Promote Philately among children at a young age in a sustainable manner that can reinforce and supplement the academic curriculum.

schemeName: J.C. Bose Fellowship
briefDescription: The “J.C. Bose fellowship” is awarded to active scientists in recognition of their outstanding performance. The fellowship is scientist-specific and very selective.

schemeName: SERB Research Scientist Scheme
briefDescription: SERB Board has launched a new ‘SERB Research Scientist (SRS) Scheme’ for the awardees of INSPIRE Faculty and Ramanujan Fellowships, who fail to secure regular positions after completion of the regular tenure of five years in the respective schemes.

schemeName: SERB International Research Experience
briefDescription: The Science and Engineering Research Board (SERB), a statutory body under the Department of Science and Technology, Government of India has launched "SERB International Research Experience (SIRE)".

schemeName: Visiting Advanced Joint Research Faculty Scheme
briefDescription: VAJRA Faculty Scheme is a dedicated program exclusively for overseas scientists and academicians with emphasis on NRI and Persons of Indian Origin/Overseas Citizen of India to work as adjunct/visiting faculty for a specific period of time in Indian Public funded academic and research institutions.

schemeName: Scheme for Goa Rajya Vidnyanik Puraskar
briefDescription: The scheme aims to introduce and recognize Goan Innovators/Scientists who have achieved excellence in the fields of Science, Technology, and Innovation. The scheme rewards eligible Students, Startups, Innovators, Research Faculty, and Scientists with three annual cash awards of ₹2,00,000/- each.

schemeName: Lab on Wheels
briefDescription: This program has been launched to promote & popularize science education among school students and youth studying science subjects across all 13 districts of Uttarakhand.

schemeName: Mukhyamantri Uchcha Shiksha Shodh Protsahan Yojana
briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote high-quality, interdisciplinary research in higher education institutions across state. The broad subject areas for research include Science, Arts & Humanities, Home Science, & Commerce & Management, while proposals in interdisciplinary subject areas are also encouraged.

schemeName: Raman-Charpak Fellowship
briefDescription: The “Raman-Charpak Fellowship Programme” is in honour of two Nobel Laureates in Physics, Prof C.V. Raman, Indian Nobel Laureate (1930) & Prof Georges Charpak, French Nobel Laureate (1992). The Fellowship was launched during the State visit of the President of France to India in February, 2013.

schemeName: Sant Sohirobanath Ambiye Dnyanvruddhi Shishyavrutti- Bursary Scheme
briefDescription: The scheme aims to universalize higher and technical education in Goa by improving access and increasing the Gross Enrollment Ratio. It provides financial assistance for eligible course fees and textbooks to support students pursuing higher and technical education in the state.

schemeName: Prime Minister’s Fellowship for Doctoral Research
briefDescription: Prime Minister’s Fellowship for Doctoral Research scheme is a prestigious initiative of Science and Engineering Research Board (SERB), Department of Science & Technology, Government of India towards the advancement of university research engagements in line with industry requirement.

schemeName: IGSTC Industrial Fellowship- Post Doctoral Industrial Fellowship
briefDescription: This programme is aimed at encouraging Postdoctoral researchers/fresh PhDs in S&T with appreciable track record and having aptitude for applied research and technology development.

schemeName: IGSTC Industrial Fellowship- PhD Industrial Exposure Fellowship
briefDescription: The "Indo-German Science & Technology Centre (IGSTC) Industrial Fellowship Programme" was launched by Secretary, Department of Science and Technology, Govt. of India on the occasion of IGSTC’s 11th Foundation Day on 14th June 2021 to support young Indian researchers for industrial exposure in German

schemeName: Women In Science and Engineering-Societal Challenges with Opportunities Fellowship
briefDescription: The “WISE-SCOPE Fellowship” Program was started by the Department of Science & Technology, Government of India with the aims to provide opportunity to Women Scientists and Technologists who have completed Ph.D. and want to utilize their S&T knowledge and expertise for the benefit of society.

schemeName: International Travel Grant Scheme
briefDescription: The scheme aims to support international participation of scientists by providing partial financial assistance for travel and registration expenses.

schemeName: Women Scientist Scheme-C
briefDescription: A scheme by MoST for female candidates with a break in their career interested in addressing societal challenges through viable S&T interventions. 1-year training is provided in Intellectual Property Rights (IPRs), patent search, know-how, drafting, filing, trademarks, trade secrets, and copyright.

schemeName: Indo-French Postdoctoral Research Programme for Women in Science
briefDescription: This programme will provide a platform for women candidates to engage & work with Indian/French scientific communities with an aim to accelerate their talented instincts towards carrying out advanced studies and research in the frontier areas of Science & Technology.

schemeName: SERB - POWER Fellowship
briefDescription: The SERB - POWER Fellowship is designed to identify and reward excellent women researchers in Indian academic institutions and R&D laboratories, holding Ph.D. degrees in any branch of science and engineering.

schemeName: SERB - POWER Research Grants
briefDescription: The aim of the ‘SERB - POWER Research Grants’ is to encourage emerging and eminent women researchers for individual-centric and competitive mode of research funding to undertake R&D activities in frontier areas of science and engineering.

schemeName: Scheme for Promoting Young Talents in Science-II
briefDescription: The scheme “Scheme for Promoting Young Talents in Science-II (SPYTiS-II)” is constituted for the purpose of providing financial and technical assistance to talented young students who have innovative ideas in scientific/technological pursuits.

schemeName: Seemant Parvatiya Janpad Baal Vigyan Mahotsav
briefDescription: It aims to provide students from classes 6 to 12 of government/non-government schools in six border districts of the state (Uttarkashi, Chamoli, Rudraprayag, Champawat, Bageshwar,Pithoragarh) with an opportunity to participate in science competitions & to promote scientific awareness in these areas.

schemeName: Prime Minister Early Career Research Grant
briefDescription: This programme is initiated by the Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF) to assist researchers to initiate their research career in a new institution with a flexible budget and progressive initiatives for ease of doing research.

schemeName: Yatra Anudan
briefDescription: The scheme aims to support researchers and scientists in attending international scientific workshops and other programs by providing eligible applicants with travel grants covering up to 50% of the expenses (maximum ₹25,000/-).

schemeName: Conducting Outreach Programmes in Various Fields
briefDescription: It aims to promote scientific awareness among students, teachers, and the general public by conducting outreach programmes and activities in various fields of science through both online and offline modes, thereby making science education and research more accessible across the state.

schemeName: Partial Travel Support Scheme
briefDescription: The Himachal Pradesh Council for Science, Technology & Environment (HIMCOSTE), has a scheme for providing partial travel assistance to deserving bright young Scientists and Research Scholars working in state

schemeName: ASEAN-India Research Training Fellowship
briefDescription: The “ASEAN-India Research Training Fellowship (AI-RTF)” is a fellowship scheme initiated by the Department of Science & Technology, Government of India under ASEAN-India Science & Technology Development Fund to support young talented researchers/scientists of ASEAN member countries.

schemeName: Kerala State Young Scientist Awards
briefDescription: The “Kerala State Young Scientist Awards” by the KSCSTE are intended to honour talented young Scientists in recognition of their outstanding contributions in any branch of science and technology coming within the purview of the Council.

schemeName: Research, Development & Innovation (RDI) Scheme
briefDescription: The Research, Development & Innovation (RDI) Scheme provides funding and support to help organizations create and improve new technologies or ideas so they can boost innovation, economic growth, and global competitiveness.

schemeName: NIDHI – Promoting and Accelerating Young and Aspiring Innovators and Startups (PRAYAS)
briefDescription: The scheme provides early-stage funding to support idea validation and proof of concept for technology-based and deep-tech innovations through PRAYAS Centres (PCs) and Advance PRAYAS Centres (APCs).

schemeName: NIDHI – Seed Support Program (SSP)
briefDescription: The key objective of the NIDHI- Seed Support Program (NIDHI-SSP) is to ensure availability of the seed support through incubators for providing timely support to potential startups, thereby enabling them to take their ventures to the next level and facilitate their success in the marketplace.

schemeName: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Faculty Fellowship
briefDescription: The "INSPIRE FACULTY FELLOWSHIP" component provides opportunities to 100 persons every year with Ph.D. qualifications in the age group of 27-32 years for 5 years to carry out research in both basic and applied science areas including engineering, medicine, agriculture, and veterinary sciences.

schemeName: Assistance to Voluntary Organisations for Promotion of the Official Languages in the Field of Law
briefDescription: The scheme aims to propagate and develop literature in the field of law in Hindi and other regional languages. It provides financial grants to voluntary organisations for publishing legal books, commentaries, and journals.

schemeName: Research and Development Programme in Water Sector
briefDescription: The scheme aims to solve water sector problems through effective research and development. It provides Grants-in-Aid to academicians, universities, laboratories, government departments, and Non-Governmental Organizations to fund basic, applied, and action research projects.
nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Water Resources,River Development & Ganga Rejuvenation

schemeName: Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics and IT: Post-Doctoral Fellowships (PDF)
briefDescription: This fellowship is meant for those who have a proven track record as evident from their research publications & recognitions. Support is provided for 225 Post-Doctoral Fellowships for candidates for a period of 1 year, to encourage specialized research in emerging area.
nodalMinistryName: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

schemeName: Dr. D.S. Kothari Post Doctoral Fellowships In Sciences
briefDescription: Dr. D.S. Kothari Post Doctoral Fellowships in Sciences was introduced by the UGC. In addition to the existing RA/PDF positions provided by various funding agencies, a need was felt for a PDF scheme running in a flexible mode, with fast track, online handling, and decision-making.

schemeName: Junior Research Fellowship In Sciences, Humanities, And Social Sciences
briefDescription: The scheme of Junior Research Fellowship in Sciences, Humanities, and Social Science by UGC, Dept. of Education, is open to candidates who qualify for the National Eligibility Test-Junior Research Fellowship(NET-JRF) of the UGC and the UGC-Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (UGC-CSIR).

schemeName: DAE-Homi Sethna Chair (DAE-HSC)
briefDescription: The scheme aims to utilize the expertise of retired scientists, engineers, and technologists by providing honorarium and research support for carrying out research and development activities in identified areas of the Department of Atomic Energy.

schemeName: Scheme for Setting Up of Centre of Excellence
briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide strategic funding for collaborative research and development in the chemicals and petrochemicals sector. It provides a grant of up to ₹5,00,00,000/- to existing Government universities and organizations for research equipment, staff, and technology commercialization.

schemeName: Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya Telecom Excellence Award
briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide national recognition, financial incentives, and professional encouragement to Indian citizens and institutions contributing significantly to telecom development and its application in sectors such as agriculture, health, education, and commerce.

schemeName: Telecom Technology Development Fund
briefDescription:
The Telecom Technology Development Fund Scheme (hereinafter referred to as ‘Scheme’) has been
notified for domestic companies and institutions involved in technology design, development,
commercialization of telecommunication products and solutions to enable affordable broadband and mobile services.

schemeName: Financial Assistance for Tagore Cultural Complexes (TCC)
briefDescription: This scheme promotes cultural activities across states and fosters unity while providing opportunities for creative expression and learning, especially for the youth.

schemeName: Personality Development and Yogasan Training Camp for Schedule Caste
briefDescription: The scheme "Personality Development and Yogasan Training Camp for Schedule Caste Youth" by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to promote the physical, mental, and spiritual development of Scheduled Caste youth through 7-day training camps.

schemeName: Scheme of Financial Assistance to Literary/Educational Institutions for Organizing Programs/Conferences
briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage intellectual and cultural activities by providing financial support to institutions conducting seminars, workshops, symposiums, and literary programs.

schemeName: Assistance to Women for Trainer and Coaches Training Course
briefDescription: The scheme “Assistance to Women for Trainer and Coaches Training Course” by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department, Government of Gujarat aims to encourage women's participation in sports by providing financial assistance for diploma courses in sports education.

schemeName: Youth Engagement through Empowered Youth Organisations (YESS)
briefDescription: The objective of this scheme is to empower young people and youth organisations by providing financial support for development activities. It aims to encourage youth participation in community service, sports, cultural events, and leadership initiatives across Meghalaya.

schemeName: Chief Ministergi Artistesinggi Tengbang (CMAT): Support For Purchase Of Instruments / Equipment
briefDescription: The scheme "CMAT: Support for Purchase of Instruments / Equipment" aims to support many talented students and budding artistes, who are economically well but in need of instruments/equipment for their learning and performance purpose to help them groom towards professionalism.

schemeName: Cash Prize to Players and their Coaches for Winning Medals in National and International Competitions
briefDescription: The scheme aims to recognize and honor players and their coaches from the state who have achieved remarkable success and won medals at the national and international level in the field of sports. There is a provision to award prize money ranging from a minimum of ₹10,000/- to a maximum of ₹2 crore.

schemeName: Mukhyamantri Udeeyman Khiladi Unnayan Chhatravriti Yojana
briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote sports among talented children aged 8 to 14 years in Uttarakhand by providing a monthly scholarship of ₹1,500. Players in this age group are selected every year on the basis of Physical & Sports Aptitude Test (P-SAT), with 150 boys & 150 girls selected from each district.

schemeName: Grant For Oru Kala Pooja
briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide annual financial assistance to Hindu Religious Institutions situated in the Union Territory of Puducherry that have poor resources. It benefits the temple authorities by covering expenses associated with the performance of Oru Kala Pooja, Current Consumption Charges, etc.

schemeName: Promotion of Acting in Tiatr for School Children
briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage school children to improve their acting abilities in Goan tiatr through organized competitions. It provides cash prizes and certificates to winners in comedy and non-comedy acting categories.

schemeName: Exhibition of Books on Tiatr, Its Song and Music
briefDescription: The scheme aims to help Roman Script Konkani writers and publishers who face difficulties in marketing their books related to Tiatr, its song and music, while promoting Tiatr culture among enthusiasts. The scheme provides bulk purchase of books at 80% of the fixed rate and organizes book exhibition.

schemeName: Documentation And Research Assistantship Scheme
briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage documentation and digitisation of valuable Tiatr-related materials to prevent their loss to posterity. It provides assistance and incentives to holders of such materials and pays honorarium to documentation assistants.

schemeName: State Art Exhibition Competition
briefDescription: The scheme "State Art Exhibition Competition" by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department, Government of Gujarat aims to promote fine arts and recognize artistic talents by providing awards and scholarships to artists, art students, and school children across Gujarat.

schemeName: Sindhu Darshan Scheme
briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹15,000/- to pilgrims from Gujarat undertaking the Sindhu Darshan Yatra in Leh-Ladakh, fostering national unity. Intended beneficiaries include native Gujaratis who complete the yatra and apply within 60 days.

schemeName: Kailash Darshan Yatra
briefDescription: The scheme provides financial assistance to pilgrims from Gujarat undertaking the Kailash Darshan Yatra. To be eligible, the applicant must be a selected pilgrim from Gujarat and submit proof of yatra completion within 90 days. Applications for this scheme are accepted offline.

schemeName: Operation of Sports Hostels
briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage tribal students to participate in sports and prepare them for national & international competitions. Tribal students from Classes 6 to 12 are provided with free accommodation, specialized training, nutritious meals & other necessary facilities in the sports hostels.

schemeName: Organisation of Cultural Programs
briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to cultural groups and artists registered with the Department for performing in cultural programs organized during traditional fairs, festivals, regional celebrations within and outside the state, as well as on the occasion of national festivals.

schemeName: Bhajan Pakhawaj Workshops
briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to provide knowledge of appropriate and traditional Bhajan Singing and Pakhawaj playing to Bhajan performers through experts from the respective field. Applications are invited by announcement in local print & electronic media. Certificates are awarded to participants.

schemeName: Travel Grants To Goan Authors
briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to enable the Goan writers to come in close contact with the senior writers of a language-region other than their own within India to acquaint them with the writers and the people of that region, and to widen their awareness and sensibility about the country.

schemeName: D. D. Kosambi Research Fellowship Scheme
briefDescription: The scheme "Goa State Best Library and Best Librarian Award" has been designed by the Directorate of Art and Culture, Government of Goa to encourage Goan Scholars to undertake research in the field of Goan history, culture, arts, social studies etc. Three fellowships shall be awarded.

schemeName: Yuva Srujan Puraskar (Navsarjan Chetana Puraskar)
briefDescription: The scheme "Yuva Srujan Puraskar (Navsarjan Chetana Puraskar)" is designed to honour the young Goan individuals who have excelled in the field of Art and culture in Goa. The scheme intends to give recognition to young artists par excellence for their outstanding achievements.

schemeName: Laxman Award / Rani Laxmi Bai Award Scheme
briefDescription: The scheme “Laxman Award/Rani Laxmi Bai Award” was launched by the Department of Sports, Government of Uttar Pradesh to honor special sports personalities of the state. The Laxman award is to male sportspersons and the Rani Laxmi Bai award is given to female sportspersons.

schemeName: Khel Chhatravriti (Vritika) Yojana
briefDescription: The "Khel Chhatravriti (Vritika) Yojana" implemented by the Directorate of Art, Culture, Sports, and Youth Affairs, Government of Jharkhand, provides financial assistance to athletes based on their performance to encourage sports as a career.

schemeName: Jharkhand Sports Excellence Cash Award Scheme to Players
briefDescription: The “Jharkhand Sports Excellence Cash Award Scheme to Players” aims to provide cash awards to athletes for exceptional achievements in national and international competitions, as per the Jharkhand Sports Policy, 2022.

schemeName: Pay & Play Scheme
briefDescription: The “Pay & Play Scheme” aims to provide state-level players with training and practice opportunities at the Mega Sports Complex, Hotwar, Ranchi.

schemeName: Madhya Pradesh Kalakar Evam Sahityakar Kalyan Kosh Niyam- Death Assistance
briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide one-time financial assistance to the dependents of deceased artists and litterateurs.

schemeName: Financial Assistance to Sportspersons to Pursue Sports Coaching Courses Conducted by SAI, NSNIS, Patiala as a Part of Skill Development Programme to Improve their Employability
briefDescription: The Scheme was launched by the Department of Sports & Youth Services Department, Government of Odisha to provide financial assistance to sportspersons of Odisha to help them become qualified coaches, by undertaking SAI, NSNIS coaching courses, so as to improve their employability.

schemeName: Scheme of Human Resources Development in Sports- Assistance to Match Officials, Coaches and Support Personnel
briefDescription: The scheme aims to develop specialists, coaches, officials, and researchers in sports. Under this scheme, fellowships, training support, research grants, and publication assistance are provided to sports personnel and institutions.

schemeName: Scheme of Human Resources Development in Sports- Exchange of Knowledge / Research / Ideas for Attending Seminars, Workshops and Conferences of Repute in India or Abroad
briefDescription: The scheme aims to enhance professional knowledge and skills in sports. Financial assistance is provided to eligible professionals for participating in reputed seminars, workshops and conferences.

schemeName: Scheme for Dronacharya Award for Outstanding Coaches in Sports and Games
briefDescription: The award for Outstanding Coaches in Sports & Games is a prestigious national sports award instituted by the Government of India to recognize coaches who have consistently demonstrated outstanding & meritorious work in training sportspersons to achieve excellence at international competitions.

schemeName: Halpati Housing Scheme
briefDescription: Under this scheme, ₹1,20,000 financial assistance is provided for self-constructed houses in rural south Gujarat to support housing needs of Halpati (Talaviya, Nayaka) caste members included in Scheduled Tribes.

schemeName: Pandit Dindayal Upadhyay Awas Yojana-Developing Caste Welfare
briefDescription: The "Pandit Dindayal Upadhyay Awas Yojana-Developing Caste Welfare" provides financial assistance of up to ₹1,20,000/- to socially and educationally backward classes, economically backward classes, and nomadic exempted castes for constructing houses across Gujarat.

schemeName: Map Simplification Process
briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide an efficient online system for landowners in Haridwar district to get approval for their residential and commercial property maps quickly and easily, ensuring transparency and reducing delays.

schemeName: Providing Model Maps for Residential Construction
briefDescription: It aims to provide landowners in Haridwar district with model maps for residential construction according to the size of their plots.

schemeName: Pandit Dindayal Upadhyay Awas Yojana (Developing Caste Welfare) (EBC)
briefDescription: The scheme aims to support Economically Weaker Sections (EWS) by offering financial aid up to ₹1,20,000/- for house construction. This scheme also ensures that Economically Weaker Sections receive support in securing shelter.

schemeName: Usha Kiran Yojana
briefDescription: In 2007, Madhya Pradesh State Government started "Usha Kiran Yojana" for women.

schemeName: Mukhyamantri Awas Yojna (HPBOCWWB)
briefDescription: The Mukhyamantri Awas Yojna, introduced by the Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HPBOCWWB), provides financial assistance of ₹1,50,000/- to registered worker.

schemeName: Running of Scheduled Caste Hostel
briefDescription: The "Running of Scheduled Caste Hostels" scheme by the Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, aims to provide housing and a conducive study environment for Scheduled Caste students. Separate junior, senior, and college hostels are operated for boys & girls.

schemeName: Banglar Awaas Yojana (BAY)
briefDescription: "Banglar Awaas Yojana (BAY)" provides financial assistance to houseless households and those living in kutcha or dilapidated houses, helping them build pucca houses with essential amenities. The scheme offers financial assistance with additional support for toilets and unskilled workdays.

schemeName: Scheme For Loan And Advances to the Beneficiary For Construction Of House
briefDescription: The Scheme for Loan and Advances to the Beneficiary for Construction of House was launched by the Tripura Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, under the Labour Department of Tripura.

schemeName: Construction of Free Houses for Tribals
briefDescription: This scheme provides free houses to tribals who already possess free house site pattas. The construction of the houses is carried out by government authorities, ensuring shelter for tribal communities.

schemeName: Loans and Advances for Construction of a House
briefDescription: The "Loans and Advances for Construction of a House" scheme by the Manipur Building and Other Construction Workers' Welfare Board provides financial support to registered construction workers to build their own houses. Beneficiaries can avail loans based on their skill level, with amounts ranging.

schemeName: Operating Sports Hostel
briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage tribal students to participate in sports and prepare them for national and international competitions by providing free hostel accommodation, food, training, and study support.

schemeName: Hostels for ST Boys and ST Girls
briefDescription: The scheme aims to attract implementing agencies for undertaking the hostel construction programme for ST Girls to reduce drop out rate. Through this scheme, central assistance for the construction/extension of hostels is provided to ST boys and girls (including Primitive Tribal Groups).

schemeName: Scheme for Promotion of Affordable Rental Smart Housing (SPARSH 2.0): Rent Subsidy
briefDescription: The scheme aims to reduce the rental burden on workers and economically weaker section families residing in affordable rental housing complexes.

schemeName: Scheme for Promotion of Affordable Rental Smart Housing (SPARSH 2.0): Construction and Redevelopment Incentives
briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage affordable rental housing development. Through this scheme, Floor Space Index benefits and regulatory relaxations are provided to eligible housing projects.

schemeName: 100% Penalty Mafi Yojana
briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial relief to beneficiaries of the Gujarat Housing Board and Slum Clearance Cell who have pending installment dues by offering a complete waiver of penalty amounts. It benefits tenants and property allottees by waiving 100% penalties on arrears if paid by 31st March.

schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin, Uttarakhand
briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide pucca houses with basic amenities to eligible rural households in Uttarakhand, ensuring dignified living conditions for economically and socially disadvantaged families.

schemeName: Atithi Uttarakhand Home-Stay Registration
briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote rural tourism and generate local employment by enabling residents to register their homes as certified home-stays that offer safe, affordable accommodation and meal facilities to tourists in Uttarakhand.

schemeName: Awas Sahayta Yojana for 100% Hearing and Visually Impaired Disabled Students in Special Trades of Industrial Training Institutes
briefDescription: The scheme aims to ensure qualitative admission and enable 100% hearing and visually impaired students to obtain high-quality technical education free from economic constraints. It provides housing assistance and expenses for food and accommodation, up to ₹4,000/- to PwD Students.

schemeName: Assistance for Completely Damaged/Destroyed Houses
briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to individuals whose residential houses have been completely or partially damaged due to natural disasters in Uttarakhand. Under this scheme, compensation is provided to disaster-affected families to support them in rebuilding or repairing their homes.

schemeName: Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose Residential Hostel
briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free hostel facilities to children (both boys and girls) aged 6 to 18 years who are enrolled in nearby schools for formal education. In addition, children are provided with a monthly stipend of ₹200/-.

schemeName: Atal Asra Yojana
briefDescription: "Atal Asra Yojana" by the Department of Tribal Welfare, Government of Goa provides financial assistance of up to ₹ 3,00,000 to individuals from Scheduled Tribes communities for construction/ re-construction and repairs of the house.

schemeName: Nirman Shramik Pucca Ghar Yojana
briefDescription: Labour and ESI Department, Government of Odisha has introduced a scheme "Nirman Shramik Pucca Ghar Yojana (NSPGY)" to meet the housing needs of the building and other construction workers in rural areas, registered under the Odisha Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (OB&OCWWB).

schemeName: Grant of House Construction Subsidy to Scheduled Caste People
briefDescription: The scheme “Grant of House Construction Subsidy to Scheduled Caste People” was introduced by the Adi Dravidar Welfare Dept, Govt of Puducherry. The poor Scheduled Caste people, and other Economically backward class people, who meet the eligibility criteria, are provided house construction subsidy.

schemeName: Housing Subsidy Scheme (GBOCWWB)
briefDescription: The main objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to construction workers registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker’s Welfare Board to build their own houses.

schemeName: Shramik Basera Yojana (GBOCWWB)
briefDescription: Under the scheme, the accommodation facilities will be provided @ ₹5/- per day to registered construction workers in temporary prefabricated housing with basic amenities that can be dismantled.

schemeName: Hostel Assistance Scheme for Children of Migrant Construction Workers (GBOCWWB)
briefDescription: Under the scheme, hostel facilities for free accommodation and meals shall be provided to the children of migrant construction workers in primary school. The aim of the scheme is to provide primary, secondary, and higher education to the children of migrant construction workers.

schemeName: Yashwantrao Chavan Mukta Vasahat Yojana for VJNTs
briefDescription: The scheme "Yashwantrao Chavan Mukta Vasahat Yojana for VJNTs," was launched by the Dept of Social Justice & Special Assistance, Govt of Maharashtra. Each VJNT family will receive a plot of land measuring 5 gunthas (approximately 500 square meters or about 5,382 square feet).

schemeName: Pucca Ghar Yojana (Mining)
briefDescription: The government of Odisha is committed to providing "Pucca Houses" to all the eligible kutcha households in all the mining-affected Blocks of nine mineral-bearing Districts.

schemeName: Mukhyamantri Vas Sthal Kray Sahayata Yojana
briefDescription: This scheme provides financial assistance to landless beneficiaries for purchasing residential land, ensuring housing for the underprivileged in rural Bihar.

schemeName: Birsa Awas Nirman Yojana
briefDescription: The "Birsa Awas Nirman Yojana" by the Welfare Department, Government of Jharkhand, provides financial assistance in three installments for housing construction to Scheduled Tribes, along with a ₹500 incentive for monitoring agencies for timely completion.

schemeName: Housing Assistance (Madhya Pradesh)
briefDescription: The scheme "Housing Assistance (Madhya Pradesh)" by the Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, provides housing support to tribal boys and girls pursuing higher education outside their hometown, where hostels are not available.

schemeName: Chief Minister's Building and Other Construction Workers Urban Housing Scheme (MPBOCWWB)
briefDescription: The scheme was revised in 2018, the "Chief Minister's Building and Other Construction Workers Urban Housing Scheme," to provide an additional ₹1,00,000 assistance to eligible construction workers in urban areas, along with grants from the Central and State Governments.

schemeName: Chief Minister's Building and Other Construction Workers Housing (Rural) Scheme
briefDescription: Launched in 2013, the "Chief Minister's Building and Other Construction Workers Housing (Rural) Scheme" provides permanent houses to registered construction workers in rural areas of Madhya Pradesh.

schemeName: Sardar Patel Awas Yojana
briefDescription: Sardar Patel Awas Yojana (SPAY) is a housing scheme launched by the government of Gujarat in India to provide affordable housing to economically weaker sections (EWS) and low-income groups (LIG) of society.

schemeName: Financial Assistance for Marriage for the Construction Workers
briefDescription: The "Financial Assistance for Marriage for the Construction Workers" by the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department, Delhi, is a welfare scheme  that provides financial assistance for marriage of self and for upto 2 children.

schemeName: Pratyasha Scheme- West Bengal
briefDescription: The Government of West Bengal has undertaken a housing project scheme named ” PRATYASHA” for Police Personnel (from Inspectors to Constables) working in the West Bengal Police to materialize their dreams of owning houses.

schemeName: Akanksha Housing Scheme
briefDescription: Akanksha Housing Scheme was launched by the Housing Department, Government of West Bengal on 28/02/2014 to provide housing to the serving State Government employees.
